fidelity: F2a — Two-Step Arrhenius Kinetics + Reactor Energy-Balance ODE
source: Di Blasi & Lanzetta (1997) J. Anal. Appl. Pyrolysis 40-41:287-303; Bergman et al. (2005) ECN-C-05-073; Prins et al. (2006) J. Anal. Appl. Pyrolysis 77:28-34; Bates & Ghoniem (2012) Bioresour. Technol. 124:460-469

unit.name: Generic Torrefaction Reactor — Physics-Lumped Two-Step Kinetics (wood chips)

A1.note: Pre-exponential factor, step 1 (B -> V1 + C1), Di Blasi & Lanzetta 1997 hemicellulose-rich wood, low-T branch

c1_solid_frac.note: Solid (intermediate char C1) mass fraction from step-1 decomposition; remainder (0.45) is volatiles V1

c2_solid_frac.note: Solid (final char C2) mass fraction from step-2 decomposition of C1; remainder is volatiles V2

reactive_frac.note: Mass fraction of feed that is thermally reactive at torrefaction T (hemicellulose + amorphous cellulose). Di Blasi-Lanzetta kinetics apply to this fraction; the rest (crystalline cellulose + lignin) is treated as inert solid that survives mild torrefaction. Bergman 2005 / Prins 2006

LHV_raw_MJ_kg.note: LHV of raw dry biomass (wood chips), matches F1a

LHV_char_MJ_kg.note: LHV of fully-carbonised char fraction (C2). Energy concentrates in solid as O/C falls (van Krevelen). Bergman 2005 / Bates 2012

LHV_volatiles_MJ_kg.note: Effective LHV of released volatiles/torgas (CO2, H2O, acetic acid, light organics — low-energy oxygenates). Prins 2006

delta_h_rxn_kJ_kg.note: Heat of torrefaction reaction per kg volatiles released; slightly exothermic at deep torrefaction. Negative = exothermic (releases heat). Bates & Ghoniem 2012; Ohliger 2013

m_feed_kg.note: Reference dry biomass batch / per-kg basis

cp_solid_J_kgK.note: Specific heat of biomass/char solid. TenWolde 1988

hA_heat_W_K.note: Overall heat-transfer coefficient * area from reactor wall to solid bed (per kg feed basis)
